'''Heavyhands''' is a [[Special Enemies|Special Enemy]] found in {{Location|Ragunna|nocat=1}}. It's located in a cave on the island Northeast of Averardo Vault. This Special Enemy becomes available after the {{Quest|Silent as a Falling Leaf}} has been completed.
